resources.string: Vula ukuze ubuke amavidiyo akho angasese
Sebenzisa ama-biometrics noma ukuvimba kwesikrini sedivayisi yakho
Setha i-PIN, iphethini, noma iphasiwedi kuzilungiselelo zefoni yakho ukuze usebenzise umtapo wolwazi wangasese.
Ukuqinisekisa akukwazanga ukuqala kule divayisi. Sicela uzame futhi.
Kuthutshiwe uye emtatsheni wolwazi wangasese. Amakhophi athunyelwe ngaphambili awashintshanga.
Akuqinisekiswanga ukuthuthela amavidiyo. Sicela uzame futhi.
Khetha amavidiyo emtatsheni wakho ojwayelekile bese uwathuthela lapha
